observations.both_hosts: Trusted frozen-image cat probes failed before executing any code; non-root saw permission denied and the root control saw missing file. Offline Docker copy verified the executable exists with mode0755 in the image. All named probe containers auto-removed; explicit image-inspection container removed afterward.
observations.explanation: Independent systemd BindPaths directives create separate slave mount views. Docker's overlay image mount is not visible to containerd's runtime, although both see the same underlying quota-backed shim-socket directory and the same network namespace. Prior admission proved the latter two but omitted image mount identity.

correction.startup: Only containerd creates the private /run/containerd bind. A separate fixed root-only agent startup role obtains the pinned live containerd mount namespace by descriptor, verifies process birth and network identity, then execs only the pinned Docker/config pair through pinned nsenter. No caller-selected program, numeric-PID namespace join, candidate or SSH authority is accepted.
correction.admission: Capture and every recheck require Docker/containerd to share one nonempty mount identity. Socket peers cannot change that captured identity, and managed shims must share their owning containerd's mount view.
correction.tests: Deterministic split/missing/device-different mount identities are refused while same-network/same-mount controls pass. Deployment template enforces the fixed startup role rather than a second engine BindPaths. CLI refuses extra arguments and mixed roles; unsupported platforms remain fail closed.
correction.native_corrected_launch: Installed on both idle private engines. Frozen image now executes as65532:65532 with network none, read-only rootfs, all capabilities dropped, pinned seccomp, core1, management CPU/memory/PID bounds. Actual UID/GID maps both0:200000:65536. All trusted probes removed; no submission was executed.
correction.goofe_native_resource_boundary_and_immed: passed with current mount-identity verifier; explicitly grading_qualified=false and baseline_ready=false

adjacent_native_failure.check: Fresh Goofe resource verification with the corrected native verifier refuses daemon cwd outside quota.
adjacent_native_failure.actual_cwd: Before correction, Docker cwd readlink was /, but its actual device/inode matched the candidate root, not host /. Thus the string alone was not proof of writes escaping quota.
adjacent_native_failure.cause: nsenter --wd opens cwd before entry and retained a mount reference from the original systemd namespace. That mount was unreachable by its canonical path in the joined view. --wdns resolves cwd after entry instead. Both installed util-linux versions explicitly support --wdns.
adjacent_native_failure.followup: Pinned startup now uses --wdns=<candidate_root>. Deployed immutable v3 on both hosts. Their daemon cwd resolves to the canonical candidate root and the frozen image still executes. Focused race3 and full agent/CLI suites passed,35.840s and0.006s. Goofe's native resource verification plus recheck passed without relaxing any guard.
adjacent_native_failure.diagnostic_evidence: /mnt/data/urnetwork-subeval-sille/state/startup-cwd-20261109-v1.trace and v2.trace; bounded root-only startup diagnostics were stopped and the canonical private service restored. No candidate or primary daemon was involved.
